reviews.conclusion: The bracket spans the final End fight, visible completion, about 14.0-14.5 s of black/credits/return, and a postfinish pause/Open-to-LAN visit lasting 0.75-1.25 s. This ordinary completion context is compatible with the -14.98565 s deficit; exact GUI advancement across credits remains unmeasured. The timed portion contains no visible reset in the proxy.

Nether exit, overworld eye throws and return to the fortress contain four explicit control/mouse/options visits totaling 11.0-13.0 s, compatible with -11.1159 s. Portal-loading samples are recorded separately. Inventory and profiler windows are not counted as pauses.

Portal construction and Nether-to-stronghold entry are followed by two options/video settings visits totaling 4.0-5.0 s, compatible with -4.4216 s. Debug/profiler overlays remain separate from paused menus.
Fortress combat contains three video/options settings visits totaling 2.75-4.25 s, compatible with -3.5154 s. Combat and pearl movement continue between visits without an observed attempt reset.

Stronghold portal activation is followed by an options/video-settings visit lasting 1.25-1.75 s, compatible with -1.5816 s. End entry occurs immediately afterward. Inventory/crafting management is not counted as paused.
During bastion gold mining, two pause/options visits total 1.0-2.0 s, compatible with -1.4673 s. Inventory use is recorded separately and is not counted as paused.

coverage.interpretation: Evidence-span interpolation between events in resolved, nonambiguous segments; not proof of continuity throughout those spans or the whole video. Matching heart modes are inference alternatives, not observed heart states.
